content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Redesign the site to be visually appealing, accessible, easy to navigate, clean, interactive, fully responsive and brand-consistent, with a shared style sheet across pages."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Design a homepage with prominent legal-help/application access, search, impact data/testimonials, streamlined news/posts/resources, newsletter signup, donations, urgent-update popups, adaptable navigation and disaster-legal-services content."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Provide an easily managed, extensible CMS; WordPress with Divi is preferred but other CMS options are permitted."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Enable FAQ-style expandable dropdown content within pages."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Provide a clickable office-location map and office lookup by ZIP code."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Support multiple publishing streams for news, blog content and job openings."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Provide an events page with an embedded calendar."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Provide a categorized and searchable resource section."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Allow creation of forms and registrations as needed."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Integrate the website with the Bloomerang donor-management CRM."},{"requirement_id":"R11","evidence":"Enable creation of redirect links."},{"requirement_id":"R12","evidence":"Migrate all existing blog items and selected existing pages to the new website."},{"requirement_id":"R13","evidence":"Provide website hosting."},{"requirement_id":"R14","evidence":"Set up Google Analytics 4."},{"requirement_id":"R15","evidence":"Provide SEO and customizable metadata for social-media sharing."},{"requirement_id":"R16","evidence":"Provide the specified TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 security encryption support."}]}
